tabContent.title: Weeks 1: Introduction and Visual Studio Code Basics
content: Get acquainted with the course objectives and structure.
Learn how to install Visual Studio Code, a popular code editor used for web development.
Discover useful shortcuts and productivity features in Visual Studio Code.

tabContent.title: Weeks 2-3: HTML Fundamentals
content: Gain a solid understanding of HTML (Hypertext Markup Language).
Differentiate between block and inline elements. Learn how to work with elements, attributes, classes, and IDs.
Incorporate various media elements such as audio, video, and images into web pages. Create hyperlinks to connect web pages.

tabContent.title: Weeks 4-5: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)
content: Understand the role of CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) in web development. Master CSS syntax and its application.
Select and style HTML elements using CSS selectors. Annotate your CSS code effectively with comments.
Manipulate colors to create appealing designs. Apply borders to elements for visual distinction. Control margins, padding, height, and width of elements.
Arrange elements in layers using z-index. Position elements precisely on web pages. Handle content overflow within elements.

tabContent.title: Weeks 6-7: JavaScript Essentials
content: Understand JavaScript syntax and fundamental concepts. Annotate JavaScript code using comments.
Declare and manipulate variables to store and retrieve data. Explore different data types in JavaScript and learn useful string methods.
Perform calculations and comparisons using arithmetic, assignment, and comparison operators. Implement conditional statements (if, else, else if, switch) for decision-making.
Work with arrays to store and manipulate collections of data.
